example: 你好！我叫小明。(Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.) — Hello! My name is Xiaoming.
谢谢你的帮助。(Xiè xie nǐ de bāngzhù.) — Thank you for your help.
明天见！再见！(Míngtiān jiàn! Zài jiàn!) — See you tomorrow! Goodbye!
我要一杯水。(Wǒ yào yī bēi shuǐ.) — I want a glass of water.
radicals: 水=water (氵 radical when on left)

example: 你吃饭了吗？(Nǐ chī fàn le ma?) — Have you eaten?
我爱我的家人。(Wǒ ài wǒ de jiārén.) — I love my family.
她是我最好的朋友。(Tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu.) — She is my best friend.
我每天学习汉语。(Wǒ měitiān xuéxí Hànyǔ.) — I study Chinese every day.
radicals: 学=learn (child 子 under a roof)

example: 我在学习汉语。(Wǒ zài xuéxí Hànyǔ.) — I am learning Chinese.

radicals: 国=country (jade 玉 inside borders 囗)

example: 这件衣服很漂亮。(Zhè jiàn yīfú hěn piàoliang.) — This dress is very beautiful.
你在哪里工作？(Nǐ zài nǎlǐ gōngzuò?) — Where do you work?
我没有时间。(Wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān.) — I don't have time.
radicals: 间=between/space (sun 日 in doorway 门)

example: 祝你生日快乐！(Zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!) — Happy birthday!
我喜欢旅行。(Wǒ xǐhuān lǚxíng.) — I love to travel.

祝你成功！(Zhù nǐ chénggōng!) — Wish you success!
身体健康最重要。(Shēntǐ jiànkāng zuì zhòngyào.) — Good health is the most important.
我的梦想是去中国留学。(Wǒ de mèngxiǎng shì qù Zhōngguó liúxué.) — My dream is to study in China.
radicals: 想=think (heart 心 + tree 木 + eye 目)

example: 这是一个好机会。(Zhè shì yī gè hǎo jīhuì.) — This is a good opportunity.
